text: I don’t know why everyone gave good reviews, but I feel disappointed when choosing to go here. I went to have my teeth scaled. The doctor said there was only a tiny cavity on the edge, it was nothing serious, so I decided to have it filled. After that, it was never the same. I felt like the doctor waited too long on my tooth. I rinsed it with warm water as usual, ate, and did everything, but my tooth was sensitive all over. I went back to see the doctor again. The doctor waited even deeper and said my tooth was cracked, all the way to the root. I was so confused. Normally, it didn’t hurt at all, there was no problem. The doctor said there was only a tiny cavity on the edge, so how did it get to that extent? I’ve never bitten anything to crack my tooth. The fix didn’t work. Now my life has changed. Even rinsing with water and brushing my teeth hurts a lot. It’s terrible. It seems like the doctor isn’t skilled. I’m not sure if he knows how to do it or not. I’m disappointed when I chose this place because I saw that there were a lot of good reviews. I tried to find information about the doctor’s license in front of the room, but it wasn’t clearly stated. I shouldn’t have changed clinics to this place. Other people might have found skilled doctors. Maybe the doctor who owns the clinic is good. I don’t know about those, but my tooth sensitivity has never gone away.

They simply said it needed to be refilled, and the dentist who performed the initial treatment referred me to another dentist because of a waiting list.
